summary.name: Apache NetBeans
summary.one_liner: Apache NetBeans is an open-source integrated development environment for building applications in Java, PHP and other languages.
use_cases: building applications with wizards and templates
contributing to an open-source IDE project
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Apache NetBeans as an IDE that goes beyond a text editor. It highlights source code both syntactically and semantically and supports easy code refactoring. It provides editors, wizards and templates to help create applications in Java, PHP and many other languages. It can be installed on any operating system that supports Java, including Windows, Linux, macOS and BSD. The page also lists mailing lists and social channels, and invites users to contribute through pull requests, issues and discussions.
notable: Semantic and syntactic source code highlighting with refactoring tools
Wizards and templates for Java, PHP and other languages
Runs on any OS that supports Java
caveats: The page does not state a specific license or version details beyond the title 'Apache NetBeans 31'
